Figure 1:Overview of our slide tasks, InfoVis, and VisSlideBench.
InfoVis is trained through three stages on four generation and editing
tasks, and VisSlideBench evaluates each task along task-specific
dimensions. Bar values are the dimension means of
Tables12–15.

Figure 5:VisSlideBench curation and evaluation.Left: task coverage and manual screening for generation and held-out editing data.
Right: representative multi-image generation and editing cases illustrate
the evaluation criteria with recorded scores and concise scoring explanations.
CF describes the scoring procedure; editing PQ explanations summarize the four AQ dimensions.
MLLM judges assess visual criteria, while OCR-based text matching evaluates text fidelity.
